'''John Ferguson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played Day 2 of the [[2010 World Championship]].<ref name="worlds2010d2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf 2010 Worlds Day 2 decklists (PDF)]</ref>
